text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! Aren't they those idols 
trending on social media?! How lucky are 
we to catch a pop-up live performance 
here!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Opportunities to observe from this close 
are rare! For the sake of researching 
beloved characters, I need to take a good, 
hard look—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, is it already time for training? 
But a delicious opportunity like this 
might never come again...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
This is also the first step toward 
becoming the strongest!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Choosing the opportunity right in front of 
her, Royce and Royce ended up ditching her 
training just like that.
